name: @divergentes/ui
description: Tokens de Divergentes. Figma exporta JSON; este paquete publica el CSS. El sitio no redefine la paleta.

scripts.build: style-dictionary build --config style-dictionary.config.js && style-dictionary build --config style-dictionary-dark.config.js && node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('theme-bridge.template.css', 'build/theme-bridge.css')"
scripts.test: node scripts/check-units.mjs && node scripts/check-ramps.mjs && node scripts/check-contrast.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run tokens && npm run build && npm test
